we improve the efficiency of the state of the art constructions for forward and backward private symmetric searchable encryption, by up to 253X for search time, up to 2X for update time, and up to 3X for communication.
we introduce the first constructions that achieve Type-I backward privacy and that are faster than previous schemes for forward and backward private searchable encryption.

our schemes improve previous constructions in the following ways: - We provide the first Type-I scheme. - We provide the most efficient Type-II scheme, with a 2.4x speed-up in the number of round-trips.
we provide three new constructions that improve upon previous ones in terms of security (Type-I and II), efficiency (Type-II) or both (Type-III).

the trade-off between the leakage and the search time is not as tight as it seemed to be.
